sources.title: Vintern-1B: An Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: Abstract. In this report, we introduce Vintern-1B (Vietnamese-InternVL2-1B), a reli-able 1-billion-parameters multimodal large language model (MLLM) for Vietnamese language tasks. By integrating the Qwen2-.5B-Instruct [1] language model with the InternViT-300M-448px [2] visual model, Vintern-1B is optimized for a range of applications, including optical character recognition (OCR), document ...
